requests.purpose: Carry one solar flood station through the film so the viewer follows its sun-charged battery, its four optical marks lighting as the water crosses them, the chip that lights an amber risk lamp on the spot and the antenna that sends the radio pulse, with every state it reaches kept for the rest of the film.
requests.prompt: Author an original finished React and SVG object in the current Remotion engine. A weathered galvanized steel post set beside a San Antonio street with a lopsided, slightly tilted instrument housing, a small dark blue solar panel with a worn corner, a short whip antenna, a battery bar window, and a column of four optical water-level marks mounted at four different heights, each with a small lens and a lamp. A cutaway view shows a small chip with thin traces and one amber risk lamp, with no logos and no real hardware brand. Late afternoon storm light from the upper left, cool sky fill, a long soft shadow, a rust drip and a dent, nothing symmetric. A disclosed illustration of the described design, never an installed unit.

clauses.text: Some people could have ankle-deep water in their yard.
UT San Antonio says the phone warning can come after that.
So its researchers built a flood station.
It charges itself from light and needs no cell tower.
Four optical sensors at different heights watch the water.
A small chip on the station runs the AI itself.
So it judges flood risk without a central server.
Its radio signal can carry more than a half-mile in streets.
In open country, up to five miles, to a hub.
At the hub, a second, larger AI maps flood paths for responders.
The university reports early chip AI validation.
Accuracy was ninety eight point eight two percent.
The announcement reports no field result.
It names no town with an installed station.

captions.text: Some people could have ankle-deep water in their yard.
UT San Antonio says the phone warning can come after that.
So its researchers built a flood station.
It charges itself from light and needs no cell tower.
Four optical sensors at different heights watch the water.
A small chip on the station runs the AI itself.
So it judges flood risk without a central server.
Its radio signal can carry more than a half-mile in streets.
In open country, up to five miles, to a hub.
At the hub, a second, larger AI maps
The university reports early chip AI validation.
Accuracy was ninety eight point eight two percent.
The announcement reports no field result.
It names no town with an installed station.

scenes.subject: A flooded San Antonio yard with no station in it, the orange ankle mark on a chain link post and the phone on the porch rail
scenes.action: Brown water tops the limestone curb, spreads across a San Antonio yard with no station in it and climbs a chain link post to its orange ankle mark.
scenes.consequence: The flash flood warning banner finally slides onto the phone, after the water is already in the yard.
scenes.source_basis: Claims c12. Disclosed illustration of the design the university describes. The accuracy is validation accuracy from initial assessments after training, the announcement reports no field result and names no installation.
scenes.medium_evidence: Registered flood-station-v1 with the fresh authored FloodStationHero and StreetHubSupport groups performing board events on the film clock.

scenes.subject: The whole prototype station at a curb, its solar panel and battery bar, and a far cell tower
scenes.action: The whole prototype flood station is revealed on its post at a curb in shallow water and a prototype tag pins beside its housing.
scenes.consequence: A dashed line leaves the antenna toward a far cell tower and stops halfway, and a no cell tower needed tag pins.
scenes.source_basis: Claims c1, c5, c6, c14. Disclosed illustration of the design the university describes. The accuracy is validation accuracy from initial assessments after training, the announcement reports no field result and names no installation.

scenes.subject: The station post's four optical lenses and the water rising past them
scenes.action: Four optical lenses at four different heights on the post catch the low light in turn.
scenes.consequence: The camera tilts down with the risen water and all four lit lenses under the surface flare one after another, from the highest to the lowest.
scenes.source_basis: Claims c2. Disclosed illustration of the design the university describes. The accuracy is validation accuracy from initial assessments after training, the announcement reports no field result and names no installation.
scenes.medium_evidence: Registered flood-station-v1 with the fresh authored FloodStationHero and StreetHubSupport groups performing board events on the film clock.

scenes.subject: The opened housing with its traces and chip, a push in on the large risk lamp and risk bar, then the distant dark server building across the road
scenes.action: Readings run in along thin traces from the four lenses and four weather sensors to one small chip, which begins to glow.
scenes.consequence: Across the road a distant dark server building stays unlit, and a dashed line from the station stops short of it and never connects.
scenes.source_basis: Claims c3, c18. Disclosed illustration of the design the university describes. The accuracy is validation accuracy from initial assessments after training, the announcement reports no field result and names no installation.
